Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. Project boards, sprints, and backlogs often need the same filters and sort orders applied again and again. Saved Views lets you configure a list exactly how you like it—filtered, sorted, grouped—and store it for one-click access later, instead of rebuilding it every time.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from "My overdue tasks" to "Design tickets in review." Views can also be shared with your team, so a manager's prioritized backlog or a QA lead's bug triage list becomes a click away for everyone who needs it, keeping the whole team aligned on the same priorities.

Saved Views works across every list in the product, syncs instantly across devices, and respects existing permissions—teammates only see what they're already allowed to see.

We built this feature based on direct customer feedback, and we think it will save real time for teams managing complex projects.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
